title: fix(app-shell): show the record Attachments panel's Upload and delete only to a caller whose sys_attachment grant allows them (objectui#12047)
body:
Fixes #12047
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`RecordAttachmentsPanel` (`@object-ui/app-shell`) now reads the caller's `sys_attachment` grant from `usePermissions().can`, the same call `ObjectDataPage`, `ObjectView` and `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` make for their CRUD affordances:

- Upload renders only with the `create` grant;
- each row's delete renders only with the `delete` grant;
- the refusal mapping (`friendlyError`) is unchanged and stays the backstop: a grant can change between render and click, and the parent-record gate judges the record, which the affordance cannot see.

No new request, and no new export, prop, type or pack key: the built `RecordAttachmentsPanel.d.ts` declares the same props as before.

## Measured: being the uploader does not open delete

The card's acceptance reads "delete shows only when the caller may delete, or is the uploader under the platform's rule". Read on objectstack `main` (`3ca71b6e`), the platform's rule is a conjunction:

1. plugin-security's CRUD check (`PermissionEvaluator.checkObjectPermission`, called by the security middleware) runs first for every caller, and objectql's `engine.ts` dispatches `beforeDelete` hooks inside `executeWithMiddleware`. A caller without `allowDelete` on `sys_attachment` is refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` there.
2. Only a caller who passes it reaches service-storage's `authorizeRows` (`attachment-access-hooks.ts`), where "the uploader governs their own attachment" compares `row.uploaded_by` with `ctx.session.userId`, or the parent record's `canEdit` decides.

So `uploaded_by` cannot open a delete the grant withholds, and it cannot close one the grant allows (the parent-editor alternative is not visible to the client). The verdict is the `delete` grant alone. The read-only pin includes a row the caller uploaded and still expects no delete; the uploader pin asserts delete on the caller's own file under the delete grant. Ablation A3 below shows the read-only pin is what goes red if delete is widened to "grant or uploader".

## While permissions load

The console's `MePermissionsProvider` renders its `loadingFallback` until it holds an answer and its `errorFallback` if the first load fails, so the panel never mounts under an unloaded provider, and a refetch keeps answering from the answer it holds. The panel's first render already has its verdict: Upload never shows and then hides. A load failure never reaches the panel (the provider shows its error screen), so it cannot hide Upload permanently. With no provider mounted (an embed), `can` answers `true` and the server's refusal stays the gate, as before.

## Tests

New `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel.affordanceGrant-12047.test.tsx` drives the real `MePermissionsProvider` (`initialPermissions`, or a deferred `fetcher`):

- a read-only grant renders no Upload and no delete, not even on a row the caller uploaded;
- a create grant renders Upload (and no delete without the delete grant);
- the uploader sees delete on their own file;
- CONTROL: Upload shown and the server refusing the attach with `PERMISSION_DENIED`: "You don't have permission to do that." still appears;
- no flash: with a deferred read-only `/me/permissions` answer, an Upload button is never attached to the DOM (a MutationObserver records every insertion);
- no provider: Upload and delete stay.

Runs on head `33ae53f4b`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 40 passed (40).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two touched TS files: 0 errors; the panel's 9 warnings are the same 9 the base file carries (linted from `3c3115e38` through `--stdin-filename`).
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, and the changeset presence / no-major / fixed / overwrite scripts: all exit 0.
- `check:eager-closure` on a console build of this head: "Console eager closure is 3163.6 KB gzipped across 289 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 40.9 KB)."
- Suites that can reach the panel from outside it (`App.uploadAltitude-10131`, `pageSchemaIntrospect`, `ObjectSettingsPanel`): Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 32 passed (32).

Ablations, through `ablation-replace` with the fix committed first; each leg restored to the HEAD blob `6223bfa12a07` with `git diff HEAD` empty:

- A1, the Upload grant gate removed: 3 red (read-only, uploader, no-flash).
- A2, `canDelete` forced to `true`: 2 red (read-only, create-grant).
- A3, delete widened to "grant or uploader": 2 red (read-only and create-grant, each on the caller's own row).

## Acceptance notes

- The left-behind `sys_file`, measured read only on objectstack `main` (`3ca71b6e`): a committed attachments-scope `sys_file` that was never attached is not reaped. The `sys_file` lifecycle declares two sweep triggers only, `ttl` on `deleted_at` and `retention` for `status: 'pending'`, and the object's own comment says "Committed rows carry neither trigger ... so they are immortal". The attachment hooks write the `deleted_at` tombstone only when the last join row goes away, which a file that never had one never reaches, and the reap guard vetoes anything not `pending` or `deleted`. The read-only `os storage orphans` inventory counts such a file and deletes nothing. Hiding Upload removes the common way into this state; a refusal after render (a grant change, the parent gate) still produces it. Per the card, the seat files the storage half on objectstack.
- Left as it is: for a caller without the create grant, the empty state still reads "No attachments yet. Upload a file to get started." with no Upload beside it. A sentence without the invitation needs a new pack key in `packages/i18n`, which is outside this claim's surface, so it goes back to the seat.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.
